name: My shelf
purpose: Browse, play, rearrange and remix immutable saved creations.
on_enter: Load six visible creation records and their thumbnails per page, not live models for entire collection.
If empty, show Make action; shelf slots remain empty.
Select persisted page if valid, else first existing page. Keep current draft separately from saved records.
on_exit: Commit completed shelf moves; clear selected-card overlays and release thumbnail resources outside cache budget.
persistence: shelfLayout is ordered creation IDs with optional empty slots. A move is one transaction with creation IDs, source/destination slot and revision guard. No creation recipe is altered.
back_rule: Back returns stored prior hub/play context; Home02. Play selected→09 saved context; Remix→03 new draft.
acceptance: Seven creations show page2 without overwriting or deleting the first six.
Move within/across pages is possible by tap-only selection.
Remix keeps the original unchanged and gets a new stable draft ID.
implementation_notes: Cabinet artwork has empty slots. Render actual thumbnails into registered anchors; examples from the art pack must never be inserted as player records.
No child-facing delete. Adult bin controls are in 16.

actions.guard: Record exists and thumbnail may be loaded independently
actions.command: Select creationId; show Play/Remix/Move actions; do not immediately launch on first tap
actions.feedback: Slot outline and one accessible name.
actions.interrupt: Selection changes do not lose unfinished draft.

actions.trigger: Tap hand or double-activation through explicit Play
actions.interrupt: Decode error shows restore/retry guidance, preserves record.

actions.command: Create independent draft with copied recipe, new seed preserved initially, parentCreationId=id; keep original immutable
actions.state_write: draft fields + activeDraftId. Unchanged remix earns no qualifying completion reward.
actions.interrupt: If another draft exists, park it before creating remix.

actions.trigger: Tap Move then tap destination; optional drag same operation
actions.guard: Selected record; destination visible or page navigated
actions.command: Enter move mode; choosing occupied slot swaps IDs; empty slot moves ID; one transaction
actions.state_write: shelfLayoutRevision++; no recipe or wallet writes.
actions.interrupt: Back/cancel before destination changes no layout; stale revision reloads layout before retry.

actions.guard: Target page exists, or move mode permits next empty page
actions.command: Commit none until destination chosen; display target six slots
actions.interrupt: Selected move source persists across pages.

actions.command: Park current unfinished draft if necessary; draft.createFresh(); route03
actions.interrupt: No deletion to free a display slot; add pages as required.
